notes: Each unit page lists only: Influence (UQ on Organic pages), Slots, Max Weight (kg), Max Space (L), Unit Weight (kg), Type, Base Health, Base Armor, Speed (m/s), View Range (m), View Type, a short description, and links to equipment lists (Engines, Storage, Computers, Weapons, Armors, Bonus, Misc, Specials; Organic pages seen without Bonus). No price, conversion path, complexity, max tech level, energy, default equipment or attack types appear on unit pages.
U-Spclst.txt lists Mamos-*, Momos-* and Momas-* names that all link to the same pages U-a010*.txt; those pages are titled Momas-*, so they are stored once.
chassis_code is derived from the page filename (U-g004m3.txt -> g004); chassis_image is the sprite file referenced on the page, recorded only where the extraction reported it.
description_summary is a paraphrase of the page description, not verbatim text.
FAC-001.txt is a faction victory-points status page (Terminus vs Brotherhood), not definitions.

glossary.Influence: A measure of your priority within your Faction's military infrastructure; higher Influence gives access to more advanced Chassis types and can differ between Divisions. Faction unit pages list the Influence required for the chassis.
glossary.UQ (Unit Quality): Label used in place of Influence on Organic (Xeno/Evo) unit pages; the Glossary has no entry defining it.
glossary.Clout: One of a hero's four attributes, the quality of the hero's political connections; contributes to the hero's Influence in each division; maximum 120.
glossary.Maximum Technology Level: A measure of the quality of technology a specific Unit can use; a Unit can equip items with a Tech Level below this value. Max Tech Level = Education/2 + Unit Level (rounded down).
glossary.Education: Hero attribute measuring formal schooling; sets Units' Maximum Tech Level (Education/2 + Unit Level); max 120.
glossary.Mechanical Aptitude: Skill to install, jury-rig and maintain mechanical systems; Weight Capacity = Base Weight Capacity x [1 + (Mechanical Aptitude/120)].
glossary.Tactics: Hero stat for command of tactical combat; limits how many Units can be sent into battle.
glossary.Unit: The machines that fight for your Hero; up to 48 owned; 6 plus one per 20 Tactics (rounded down) can be deployed in battle.
glossary.Chassis: The body or appearance of a Unit; units with the same Chassis share base health, armor, speed, equipment options and biological/mechanical type.
glossary.Base Weight: The contribution of a Unit's Chassis to the Unit's Weight Capacity.
glossary.Base Health: The contribution of a Unit's Chassis to the Unit's Maximum Health.
glossary.Base Armor: The portion of a Unit's Armor that comes from its Chassis: Armor = Base Armor + Equipment Armor Bonus.
glossary.Armor: Defensive protection; its value is subtracted from each incoming hit's damage.
glossary.Level - Unit: The skill and training of a Unit; starts at 1 and rises when it earns enough Experience Points.
glossary.View: Distance a unit can see terrain, units and structures; directional (Cone) or radial (Omni); mainly set by chassis and sensors.
glossary.Complexity: No Glossary entry; the term does not appear in Glossary.txt or FAC-001.txt.
